snippet.title: SECTION Z (ARCADE - FULL GAME)
snippet.description:
Zeus presents Section Z for the Arcade, a true classic from the golden era of arcade gaming which must not be forgotten alongside the software house and all programmers that were involved in making this game.

Year of release: 1985

Quite a fun game from the old archives of Capcom, had it on a PS2 compilation but couldn't get far in it, that was until I downloaded MAME which allowed me to use invincy cheat ;-D
The game is quite fun as said, you need to reach section "Z" to beat the boss which then results in game returning back to the beginning,...only harder.
Nice classic game!

I hope all you retro game fans enjoy this upload enough to subscribe and if you feel like supporting me and keep the channel content coming then please support via donatation via my PayMe Paypal as every little helps: https://www.paypal.me/Zeusdaz/0 

Please note: NONE of my game uploads are emulated in any way whatsoever, they are 100% original recordings by myself taken directly from the original hardware the game was intended for, that way you know you're watching the real thing (but not in this upload, MAME emulation).
I will also always state whether I'm using any cheats in the game, if not mentioned then i am not using any.
Check out my channel (http://www.youtube.com/user/ZEUSDAZ/videos), dedicated to gamers who loved the games of yesteryear.

Switch to 480p for best video quality and feel free to leave comments on my channel and vid's.

Keeping the memory of the Arcade games alive!!!
